result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. The change is one `ORDER BY` in `DataStorePart10.java` (`listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion`, around line 827). It uses the same clause as the sales-rep query, so closed tickets and other regions are still excluded.

`mvn -q -o test -Dtest=RegionManagerTest,SupportTicketTest` ran with no failures. I did not add a test for the new ordering, so the example from the task (T-3, T-5, T-2, T-4, T-1) is not covered by an automated check yet. Nothing is committed.
